text:
Alex: Pushed a quick prototype of the regression-diff timeline to the Figma link (screenshot attached). Want quick UX + a11y nits before we lock this for eng. TL;DR: scrubber, compact markers, inline annotations when hovered.
Mai: Nice! general thought — the active marker currently blends into the background. contrast feels low on the blue. Recommend using #0057D1 or adding a 2px white outline.
Jordan: Agree on contrast. Also we need keyboard support: left/right to move scrubber, Enter to open detail panel, and a visible focus ring. For SRs, add an aria-live region that announces "Diff X of Y: regression in test <name>".
Sam: UX question — when multiple diffs overlap in time we stack markers. It becomes noisy. Could we cluster with a count badge and expand on click? e.g., small pill "+3" that shows mini-list in the panel.
Anita: Copy nit: the primary CTA on the detail panel says `Show changes` — feels vague. Suggest `View regression details` or `Open diff details`. Also the microcopy for resolved diffs should read "No regression detected" instead of "Clean" for clarity.
Alex: Good calls. For clustering I was thinking heatmap density + hover to reveal names. But explicit count pill is clearer.
Jordan: Also add an offscreen label on the timeline: `aria-label="Diff timeline: use arrow keys to navigate. Press enter to open details."`. And when the panel opens set focus to the first interactive element.
Mai: Accessibility color check: badges (green/orange/red) need >=3:1 contrast against the white panel. If we can't get that we should add an icon with text fallback.
Sam: On mobile, the scrubber needs to be draggable and have a large touch target (>=44px). Also collapse long test names to ellipses and show full on tap.
EvalBot: Automated note — eval run 1787 attached. Summary: 12 diffs, 3 regressions. Pull request #412 will wire timeline events into the detail panel.
Alex: Implementation detail for eng — I'll add an example aria snippet to the spec: `aria-label="Diff timeline - regression 3 of 12 (test: prompt-set:signup-flow)"` and a `role="slider"` fallback for key navigation. Thoughts?
Anita: Love the slider fallback. One more small UX nudge — make the timeline height configurable in settings (compact / regular) so power users can squeeze more info.
Jordan: Accessibility QA checklist: keyboard nav, focus management, aria-live announcements, contrast ratio report, screen reader walkthrough (NVDA + VoiceOver). Can ops folks add this to the release checklist?
Sam: For the scorecard integration: add a small link "View in scorecard" that deep-links the currently selected diff so reviewers can jump straight to approval flows.
Mai: Visual tidbit — when hovering a marker show a subtle drop shadow and a 140ms fade for the tooltip. Avoid instant popups.
Alex: Awesome feedback. I'll update the Figma + spec and post a PR by EOD with the aria examples and compact/regular layout variants. Thanks all :rocket:
